name: Hyundai Elantra N MT
notes: Calibrated against kdmlinktest2.csv Elantra N manual capture. TPMS omitted (0x593 carries 0xFF only). 2.0.5: power/torque enabled - EMS16 TQI (0x260 D1) x0.390625, referenceTorqueNm 500, staticFrictionTorquePct 6.5. 2.0.6: rpm-dependent frictionTorqueCurve added (measured live TQFR 4.7%@2750 to 11.7%@5700 on the 2026-08-02 VN MT WOT capture, same G4KH engine; 6800 rpm tail point extrapolated); flat 6.5% overstated top-end power by ~5%. staticFrictionTorquePct kept as fallback for older apps. powerGaugeMaxHp 360. 2.0.7: inherits the model-base FuelLevel fix - 0x5CD D0 was a constant non-fuel byte (the stuck-fuel bug); fuel now decodes 0x50C D3:D4 sender counts (verified decreasing across MT captures, full-tank rail 2358 counts on the Jun-15 MT log).
